messages:
Nina Lopez: Notice: after RBAC change to models/data-plane in EU private, a couple of pods saw KMS 403s. Any immediate eyes?
sec-bot: ALERT: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE cluster=eu-priv count=8 severity=high
Tom Becker: which PR? can we roll back quickly?
Nina Lopez: PR 1450 merged ~2026-03-24T11:05Z. We removed broad decrypt from the rolebinding. Patch we applied: kubectl -n models patch rolebinding data-plane-kms --patch '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"data-plane","namespace":"models"}]}'
DevSec: check keystore logs and networkpolicy. If the SA-to-principal mapping was unchanged, likely the IAM binding in keystore policy was removed.
Tom Becker: ran curl to keystore from pod -> /health 200. Keystore audit shows principal=system:serviceaccount:models:data-plane action=decrypt result=DENIED reason=missing-iam-binding
Nina Lopez: I'll revert the RBAC change now to restore availability.
sec-bot: ACTION: rollback started by Nina Lopez at 2026-03-24T11:12:30Z
Tom Becker: post-rollback audit shows ALLOWED at 11:13:05Z. Recovered.
DevSec: follow-up: create key-scoped least-privileged binding, add a CI canary that runs a decrypt test after RBAC changes, and document in INC-2026-037.
Nina Lopez: PR 1453 created for minimal binding + canary. Closing incident after postmortem.
